methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: The "Right Now" Camera
content: Problem: Students often confuse Present Simple (routines) with Present Continuous (actions happening right now), forgetting the "to be" verb or the "-ing" tail.

Solution: We introduce the "Live Camera" concept. When the camera is recording right now, the action gets an "-ing" tail, and it always needs a helper (am/is/are) holding the camera. Students act as "Live Reporters" describing exactly what they see at this very moment. TPR emphasizes the ongoing nature of the action (e.g., continuously moving arms while saying "runn-ing").

methodology.title: 2.4 Teacher Notes: Pull-Out Tasks & Communicative Task
content: S1 pull-out: Show an action flashcard (e.g., running). Student makes a "He/She is..." sentence: "He is running."
S2 pull-out: Show a flashcard with multiple people. Student makes a "They are..." sentence: "They are talking."
Communicative task: Information Gap (Section 8). Student A has a picture of half the park, Student B has the other half. They ask "What is he doing?" to fill in their scene.

games.name: Vocab Slam
games.session_fit: All formats — best after vocab intro (P3) in any session
games.materials: Vocab flashcards W15: running, walking, sitting, eating, playing
instructions: Round 1: Teacher calls a Vietnamese meaning — first student to say the English word AND use it correctly in a sentence wins the card.
Round 2: Reverse — teacher calls English word, student gives Vietnamese + memory trick.
Bonus round: Students chain all vocab words (running, walking, sitting, eating, playing) into one connected story using sequence connectors from this week.
Team variant: 2 teams, 10 cards per round. Team with highest score wins.

games.name: Grammar Relay
games.session_fit: Best in Drill slot (Slot 2) or after P4/P6 in 3-session mode
games.materials: 10 sentence cards — 5 correct, 5 with errors based on: Present Continuous: am/is/are + V-ing
instructions: Grammar focus this week: Present Continuous: am/is/are + V-ing.

Fix-It: For error sentences, team that corrects fastest AND explains the rule earns double points.
Build: Each team member adds 1 original sentence using the grammar target. The chain must be logically connected — each sentence must link to the previous.

games.session_fit: All formats — best in final slot of the week (S3 / Slot 5 / Session B)
games.materials: Story starter card: theme "Community & Routines — The Busy Park (Actions Now)"
